status: Working local LibreChat fork with Canvas, document reading, public research and a limited browser. The agreed next work is an assignment dashboard, personal course folders, destination selection, common project assignment context and live view-only collaborators. These flows are not implemented yet.
scope_change: Keep the limited WebbGPT replacement candidate. Lead with upcoming Canvas assignments and course/project organization while preserving unfiled chats and projects. Course folders require a persistent explicit choice; project assignments supply context across all project chats. Collaborators are live viewers only. Microsoft expansion and multi-author collaboration remain deferred.
current_scope: Use LibreChat's native chat, personal projects, tools, attachments, exports and institutional administration.
Make the school home an upcoming-assignment dashboard with separate Open in Canvas, Start chat and Add to project actions.
Generate and refresh personal app course folders from Canvas after an explicit remembered Allow/Don't allow decision. Keep the dashboard prompt visible until answered.
Open a destination picker from generic New chat: no folder, course root, existing project, new project in a course, or new unfiled project.
Import all explicitly added project assignments as common context across every project chat, with source freshness and bounded document retrieval.
Preserve useful ordinary chat, teacher assistance guidance, help choices, inspectable evidence, Stop and a reviewed AI-use summary.
Let named collaborators, including teachers, view the latest chat automatically. The owner alone controls messages, context and assistant execution.
Evaluate a small approved model choice and one isolated academic Python task in the Webb study before expanding connectors.
retained_boundaries: Do not replace Canvas, email, messaging, or authoritative document storage.
Keep prose portable in Markdown; do not build a live Word editor.
Connected sources remain within the person’s existing access.
School hosting is distinct from the approved model provider’s data handling.
deferred: Multi-author chat, in-chat comments, shared agent execution and parallel-agent orchestration.
Outlook/mailbox access and additional GitHub/Slack connectors.
Authenticated browser sessions, extensions, student-machine execution and general student terminal access.
External cloud task-folder provisioning and folder permission management, working-copy integration, merging and real-time collaborative editing.
LTI launch, course roster sync, per-course budgets and multi-school hosting until independently justified.

archive.contains: Earlier pitch, complete interactive mockup, design log, Markdown example bundle, and final screenshots.

reuse_plan.upstream: Native chat and AI runtime; personal projects and common instructions/reference files; school SSO; groups/permissions; approved model/tool configuration; balances; shared agents; owned file handling; access-controlled snapshot sharing as a distinct mode.
reuse_plan.evaluate: Approved model quality/cost; deployment isolation and lifecycle behavior; the existing admin panel's deployment readiness. Earlier connector and institutional precedents remain dated research in references.json.
reuse_plan.custom: Existing school Canvas/document integrations; next, dashboard, personal course destinations, persisted folder choice, project assignment context, New chat picker and explicit latest-chat viewer access. Continue assistance guidance, evidence/control usability and reviewed disclosure.
reuse_plan.avoid: A new harness, LMS, shared filesystem, or editor. No current scope is selected merely because a plugin or upstream feature exists.

implemented: Approved helper/model selection and help styles.
Canvas course/material picker and sample source inspection.
Local sample CSV calculation and chart.
Educator helper publishing to a sample group.
Institution profile, people access toggles, and account allowance views.
not_implemented: Actual LibreChat fork, login, live model inference, or tool execution.
Canvas / Microsoft account authorization or API calls.
General-purpose source grounding, document parsing, live sharing, security enforcement, or retention services.
prototype.storage: New browser-local key fieldwork-librechat-pilot-v1. Earlier prototype state is kept separate.
prototype.scope: Historical HTML simulation as of October 28. The November 24 dashboard/viewer flows are specified in ../docs/dashboard.md, not implemented in this mockup. Runtime status is recorded in ../docs/school.md.

privacy_and_authorization: Explicit per-user source connections and server-authorized project context. Personal course organization never grants other people access. Named live viewers see the selected conversation's existing history and future updates plus explicitly included files, without mutation or tool/account authority. Keep personal memory off by default in the intended study profile and disclose retention/operator access.
prompt_guidance: Help styles and teacher instructions guide assistance; missing guidance remains unknown. Platform and connector controls enforce actual authorization. Help instructions cannot certify academic integrity or constrain other AI apps.
provenance: The October HTML/CSS/JavaScript, branding and sample data were original for the concept. Its historical validation below applies to that simulation. The live fork reuses LibreChat and separately recorded components; runtime status, attribution and verification are documented under ../docs/.

validation.limit: Historical HTML simulation checks only. Current runtime verification and deployment limits are recorded in ../docs/school.md and ../docs/browser-audit.md.

priority_order: Agree study activities and teacher assistance guidance with students and faculty.
Add course destinations, remembered folder permission and project assignment associations; build the dashboard and New chat picker.
Connect common assignment context across project chats and improve evidence/control usability and reviewed disclosure.
Add explicit live view-only chat grants, current-message updates, included-file access checks and revocation.
Evaluate approved model choice and advance isolated Python through one concrete data/research activity.
Evaluate complete activities against existing WebbGPT and participants' usual tools before expanding connectors.
excluded: Automated grading, academic misconduct detection or decisions, and student surveillance analytics.

scope_history.decision: Limit the product to a LibreChat fork; preserve the independent agent workspace in the archive.
Use Webb context and freshman reflections to prioritize academic activities, assistance clarity, student control, evidence and a comparative study. Defer mailbox expansion.

Adopt an upcoming-assignment dashboard, remembered automatic course folders, a New chat destination picker and common project assignment context. View-only collaborators follow the latest chat automatically; snapshots alone do not satisfy this requirement.

dashboard.course_folder_prompt: Stays on the dashboard until Allow or Don't allow; choice persists across sessions and devices and can be changed in settings.
dashboard.notifications: Browser push notifications are not part of this choice.
dashboard.project_context: All admitted assignments in a project contribute common context across new and existing project chats on subsequent turns; chat transcripts are not automatically combined.

collaboration.updates: Named viewers automatically see the latest saved chat without owner republishing.
collaboration.scope: Selected conversation and explicitly included files; not the entire project, course or source account.
collaboration.control: Only the owner changes messages/context, runs/stops the assistant or manages viewer access.
collaboration.snapshot_sharing: Remains separate; existing snapshot links are not silently converted into live access.
